title: Dimensional Formula Check
q_prose: Two statements are given about dimensions of specific heat and gas constant. Decide which statement is correct.
q_reminder: Check the dimensions of specific heat and gas constant.
q_narration: We are given two dimensional formula statements, one for specific heat and one for the gas constant. Let us solve step by step.

steps.label: Step 1 — Specific heat relation
steps.narration: Heat has the same dimensions as energy. So we start from heat equals mass into specific heat into temperature change.

steps.label: Step 2 — Dimension of specific heat
steps.narration: Mass cancels out, leaving length squared, time power minus two, per kelvin. So statement one is correct.

steps.label: Step 3 — Gas constant relation
steps.narration: For the gas constant, we use the ideal gas equation. Number of moles is treated as a separate amount count here, so we compare pressure times volume per temperature.

steps.label: Step 4 — Dimension of gas constant
steps.narration: Pressure into volume gives energy dimension. Dividing by temperature gives time power minus two, not time power minus one. So statement two is incorrect.

answer_narration: Therefore, statement one is correct but statement two is incorrect. Keep practicing with Acharya for more clear exam solutions.

options: Statement (I) is incorrect but statement (II) is correct
Both statement (I) and statement (II) are incorrect
Both statement (I) and statement (II) are correct
Statement (I) is correct but statement (II) is incorrect
